audit.why: 53.29% over 3432 games with diff FAV and 7.5/10 is coherent: Karma out-ranges Shen early (Inner Flame 950 vs Shadow Dash 600) but has no way to kill a Ki Barrier front-liner once he is itemised.
audit.corrected: Difficulty kept at 7.5/10, carry threat 6/10; prose reworded to name the real lockdown (Focused Resolve, W) instead of a fictional RQ root.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with itself and with the packet: whys[2] argued Karma wins Level 3 while win[2]/phases[2].side both said Shen, and whys[4]/phases[4].why argued Shen wins Level 6 while win[4]/phases[4].side both said Karma.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is [Karma, Skill, Karma, Shen, Shen, Shen, Shen]. Level 3 is Karma's Mantra-W + Soulflare window; Level 6 is Stand United, which is Shen's largest spike in the matchup. The mirror audit (karma__shen) reported its chart already matched the packet, so the inverse must hold here.
audit.corrected: Level 3 flipped to Karma (rating 4/10) and Level 6 flipped to Shen (rating 7/10) in BOTH layers as one atomic group, with phases[2].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields (whys[2], spikes[0].text, early, wants.foe[1]) attributed the root to 'Soulflare' / 'RQ'. Karma's Mantra-Q (Soulflare) has no root: Riot's text gives it a delayed cataclysm only. The root is Focused Resolve (W), and Mantra-W is what extends it (and heals her).
audit.why: Kit text: W 'If the tether is not broken, the enemy will be rooted... Mantra Bonus: strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration.' Q Mantra Bonus is damage-after-delay. Telling a Shen to dodge the orb to avoid the root sends him into the actual root.
audit.corrected: Root re-attributed to Focused Resolve (W) — 675 range, flat 12s at every rank, breaks on line of sight or range — in whys[2], spikes[0].text, early and wants.foe[1]. Mantra-W self-heal added to breakdown.mid with the Grievous Wounds call.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Spirit's Refuge' and 'Stand United' as suspect ability names. Both are Shen's real W and R.
audit.corrected: No change — both suspectNames entries are false positives.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Karma must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Mantra-W extends her root and Soulflare lands on top — her strongest kill window. Keep the wave near you and dodge the tether.

edits.before: Her RQ (Soulflare) root-plus-tether combo holds you in place at max Q burst range — the tether damage keeps landing even after the root, and your E cannot reach her if she fires from range.
edits.after: Her root is Focused Resolve (W), 675 range on a flat 12s cooldown, and Mantra extends it — tethered from there your Shadow Dash (E) cannot reach her before Soulflare (RQ) detonates.

edits.before: Karma's RQ (Soulflare) root lands hardest here — her tether holds you in place after the root, so dodge or you eat the full burst before your E can answer.
edits.after: Focused Resolve (W) is the root, not Soulflare — she tethers you at 675 and detonates the RQ zone on top, so break line of sight or eat it all.

edits.before: Karma's Inner Flame (Q) has the range to poke you without ever stepping into Shadow Dash range at Level 1, and you have no answer — accept the first few trades and focus on getting the blade back with Q to block return damage. At Level 2 you have E, but Karma can W-tether hold you in place after a Soulflare root, so don't dash straight into her — angle your E so the taunt lands before the tether pulls. At Level 3, her RQ root is her strongest kill threat: she lands the orb, roots you at tether range, and dumps the secondary burst while you cannot dash away. Dodge the initial orb; if it misses she has no kill pattern and you can trade freely on the cooldown.
edits.after: Karma's Inner Flame (Q) pokes from 950 while Shadow Dash (E) reaches 600, so at Level 1 you cannot answer — take the chip and pull the blade back through her for the empowered autos. At Level 2 the danger is Focused Resolve (W): 675 range, flat 12s at every rank, and it roots you only if the tether survives its duration. Walk out of range or break line of sight and it does nothing — that is your whole Level 2. At Level 3 her kill pattern is Mantra-W, which extends that root long enough for Soulflare (RQ) to detonate on you. Bait or dodge the tether; with W down for 12 seconds she has no lockdown and you trade freely.

edits.before: Root you with Soulflare's tether then move-speed out of Shadow Dash range to deny your taunt pattern entirely
edits.after: Root you with Focused Resolve (W) then Inspire (E) move-speed out of Shadow Dash range to deny your taunt entirely

edits.before: Trade strictly around Focused Resolve: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Focused Resolve's flat 12s: when it is down, run your full pattern. Mantra-W heals her through chip, so extended trades want Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: Weather the poke — taunt him on the Focused Resolve cooldown and win the map with R. Shen wins the Focused Resolve cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — taunt her in the 12s Focused Resolve window and win the map with Stand United. Her root is her only lockdown.

notes: Karma is referred to as 'him/his' across many full-layer fields (tradeGood, ahead, dosFull[0-2].d, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, report[*]). I fixed it only where I was already rewriting for substance; the rest is a mechanical pronoun sweep better done by a script than by 15 length-banded prose edits. Also: the two layers agreed with each other but BOTH disagreed with the packet at Level 3 and Level 6, and in both cases the 'why' prose argued the packet's side, so the side tokens were the wrong half. Flipped as one atomic group with matching ratings.
